name: Paleontological Polyurethane Foam Kit
visual_identity: A professional-grade, two-part polyurethane foam kit. Features two distinct, industrial-style metal canisters (one labeled 'Part A' and one 'Part B') with color-coded nozzles and clear, bold warning labels. The foam itself is shown partially extruded, expanding from a nozzle onto a small, irregularly shaped fossil fragment, appearing as a dense, off-white, slightly textured, rapidly curing material. The background implies a field setting with dusty, reddish earth.
notes: Emphasizes the foam in its active, expanding state, demonstrating its use for fossil jacketing and stabilization. The canisters should look durable and practical for field use, with legible branding.
